_comment: Per-route allowed_unregistered counts. The OpenAPI coverage check (scripts/check-openapi-coverage.ts) fails when a route file exceeds its baseline. New routes default to 0 (must be documented). To migrate a file, add registerPath calls and lower its number here — `npm run check:openapi-coverage` prints a `Suggested baseline:` block whenever a file dropped below its allowance.

api-docs.note: Swagger UI static-asset routes: GET /api/docs/openapi.yaml returns the committed YAML spec verbatim — documenting it in OpenAPI itself adds no caller-visible contract.
